A.name: Stack A: Sovereign High-Accuracy Layout RAG
A.tagline: IBM Docling parses complex PDFs & tables at 93.6% accuracy, Qdrant indexes hybrid vectors, AnythingLLM chats with page citations, Apache Tika handles legacy OCR.

B.name: Stack B: Enterprise Document Vault & Automated Ingestion
B.tagline: Paperless-ngx archives & OCRs incoming files, Weaviate runs BM25+vector hybrid search, Open WebUI serves multi-model RAG chat, n8n automates folder/email ingestion.

docling-serve.name: IBM Docling Serve
docling-serve.role: Layout-aware PDF/DOCX/PPTX parser with 93.6% table structure accuracy & UI
docling-serve.first_run: Open /ui to drag-and-drop PDFs or POST to /v1/convert/file for structured Markdown & JSON tables.

qdrant-rag.name: Qdrant Vector DB
qdrant-rag.role: Sub-10ms dense + sparse hybrid vector store with built-in Web Dashboard
qdrant-rag.first_run: Inspect collections, payload filters, and HNSW vector graphs directly at /dashboard.

anythingllm.name: AnythingLLM RAG Studio
anythingllm.role: Turnkey document workspace with citation grounding, permissions & agent skills
anythingllm.first_run: Create a workspace, connect Qdrant (:6710) or built-in LanceDB, and chat over Docling Markdown.

tika-ocr.name: Apache Tika + Tesseract
tika-ocr.role: Fallback parser & OCR engine for 1,000+ legacy Office, email & scanned formats
tika-ocr.first_run: PUT any binary file to http://localhost:6730/tika or /rmeta for instant text + metadata extraction.

paperless-ngx.name: Paperless-ngx Vault
paperless-ngx.role: Self-hosted document management system with auto-OCR, tagging & full-text search
paperless-ngx.first_run: Default local login: admin / admin12345 (customizable in .env). Drop PDFs to auto-archive & tag.

weaviate-rag.name: Weaviate Hybrid Search
weaviate-rag.role: AI-native vector + BM25 keyword hybrid database for legal & financial RAG
weaviate-rag.first_run: Query /v1/graphql with hybrid alpha=0.5 to blend exact SKU/clause matching with semantic search.

open-webui-rag.name: Open WebUI Doc Chat
open-webui-rag.role: Multi-model knowledge base chat UI wired to local Ollama & Docling loaders
open-webui-rag.first_run: No login required locally (WEBUI_AUTH=False). Attach Knowledge collections to any model.

n8n-ingest.name: n8n Document Pipeline
n8n-ingest.role: Automated watch-folder, Gmail & S3 -> Docling -> Vector DB ingestion orchestrator
n8n-ingest.first_run: Import /automations/stack_a_docling_qdrant_ingest.n8n.json to automate zero-touch PDF indexing.
